mentions.name: Tell Me a Penguin
mentions.description: Endless Mad Libs style fill-in-the-blank story generator where families can write stories about any topic they want. Includes a synced family library so stories are available regardless of which device or parent is using it, family invites, and a streamlined flow for installing the app on kids' devices.
mentions.problem: The family loved the Mad Libs format but never carried around the paper booklets, and getting an app onto a kid's iPad required manually typing passwords multiple times.
mentions.audience: Kids and their parents in a family, who want fill-in-the-blank stories on any device
mentions.source_excerpt: Just launched an endless Mad Libs style fill-in-the-blank story generator. My kiddos (and we parents) love the format, but we never carried around the paper booklets, and this way we can write them about whatever we want
mentions.author: kristjan
